title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17

ai_review.summary: A stellar post‑drums sequence with soaring Garcia and Phil bass fireworks, captured in a solid recording despite minor cut‑offs.
ai_review.review: The show shines in its second half, especially the Space → Spanish Jam → The Other One → Morning Dew → Sugar Magnolia stretch, where Garcia’s noodling and Phil’s “bombs” drive the intensity to hair‑raising heights. The recording is generally clear and enjoyable, though the tail end of Drums is truncated and the source type isn’t specified.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review (4‑star) describing a strong musical performance with minor recording glitches; rating aligns closely with reviewer’s score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound; no major mix issues noted, but the last few minutes of Drums are cut from the tape.

standout_songs: Space > Spanish Jam > The Other One > GDTRFB > Morning Dew > Sugar Magnolia
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is solid but mid‑show lull due to new, undercooked material; the post‑drums second half builds momentum with a powerful jam sequence that lifts the overall energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia “noodles nicely” and delivers brawny, blistering leads throughout the jams, especially in Space and Morning Dew.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is highlighted repeatedly – his “bombs” drive the intensity, with standout moments during The Other One, Sugar Magnolia, and the post‑drums climax.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir adds to the intensity envelope, joining Garcia on jam sections and pushing the overall energy higher.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are described as “drums,” but the recording cuts off the last few minutes of the drum segment.
